integrity: Proof gives an equivariant quotient model; finite verification is illustrative, not a proof of the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Complete split graphs with m,n>=2 and 3<=t<=m+1 only; no shellability assertion. The previously available nonequivariant four-clique-free clique-join case is not claimed as novel. Inaccessible unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Integral equivariant homotopy of clique-free complexes of complete split graphs
